import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext'; const Home = () => { const { t, appData } = useLanguage(); const [dialoguesPreview, setDialoguesPreview] = useState([]); const [storiesPreview, setStoriesPreview] = useState([]); const [flashcardsPreview, setFlashcardsPreview] = useState([]); useEffect(() => { if (appData) { // Load preview data setDialoguesPreview(appData.dialogues?.slice(0, 3) || []); setStoriesPreview(appData.stories?.slice(0, 3) || []); setFlashcardsPreview(appData.flashcards?.slice(0, 3) || []); } }, [appData]); return (
{/* Hero Section */}

{t('heroTitle', 'Learn languages naturally and fun')}

{t('heroSubtitle', 'Master new languages through real dialogues, engaging stories and smart flashcards.')}

{/* Dialogues Container */}

{t('navDialogues', 'Dialogues')}

{t('featureDialoguesDesc', 'Learn with authentic conversations in everyday situations.')}

{dialoguesPreview.map((dialogue, index) => (

{dialogue.title}

{dialogue.description}

))} {dialoguesPreview.length === 0 && (

{t('loadingDialogues', 'Carregando diálogos...')}

)}
{/* Stories Container */}

{t('navStories', 'Stories')}

{t('featureStoriesDesc', 'Short engaging stories written specifically for your level.')}

{storiesPreview.map((story, index) => (

{story.title}

{story.description}

))} {storiesPreview.length === 0 && (

{t('loadingStories', 'Carregando histórias...')}

)}
{/* Flashcards Container */}

{t('navFlashcards', 'Flashcards')}

{t('featureFlashcardsDesc', 'Smart flashcards with spaced repetition system.')}

{flashcardsPreview.map((flashcard, index) => (

{flashcard.front}

{flashcard.back}

))} {flashcardsPreview.length === 0 && (

{t('loadingFlashcards', 'Carregando flashcards...')}

)}
); }; export default Home;
